html:
Inclusions

● AC transportation by car/ Bus

● 02 night stay in3/4 star hotel in Cao Bang & Ba Be (02 persons in a room)

● 2 breakfasts, 3 lunches and 2 dinners)

● Visiting boat on Ba Be Lake

● Entrance ticket in Pac Po, Ban Gioc

● English speaking tour guide

● 01 bottle of water is served everyday on the car/ Bus .

● Electric car in Pac Bo

Exclusions

● VAT invoice, travel insurance

● Additional fee if there is any change in ticket prices

● Beverages for meals and other personal expense

● Tip for driver and tour guide

● Visa entry Viet nam

●internetional, domestics flights

●Travel insurence

● bamboo raft in Ban Gioc water fall

Price Policy for Children

  • Free for children with ages from 1 to 4 (their parents must pay for all their other expenses and 1 to 3 year-old children do not have their own seats in the car). In case one person takes one child from 1-3 years old. The child will be charged 50% of the adults; price (the child will have meals and a seat).
  • From 5 to 9 year-old children will be charged 75% of the tour fee (they will have their own seats in our car and their own meals, but they have to share the hotel room with their parents)
  • From 10-year-old children are considered as adults
